sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about admissions, batches, testing methodology, and facilities at SCIMEE.

faqs.question: Who can enroll in SCIMEE programs?
faqs.answer: We offer dedicated courses for Class 5th to 10th (Pre-Foundation Maths & Science), Class 11th & 12th (State Board & CBSE + NEET Integrated), NEET Repeaters / Dropper batch (12th Pass), and MHT-CET / JEE Foundation aspirants.

faqs.question: How do I enroll or book a counseling session?
faqs.answer: You can directly call our helplines at +91 9175013140 or +91 9226134986, click the 'Call Now' button on this website, send a WhatsApp enquiry, or visit our institute at Khadka Square, Beside Kali Matti Ground, Opposite Sunrise Apartment, Bhusawal.

faqs.question: What is SCIMEE's track record in NEET-UG?
faqs.answer: SCIMEE has placed 45+ students directly into medical colleges (MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, etc.). In our recent NEET UG 2026 batch, 100% of enrolled students (16 out of 16) qualified, led by top scores like Naushin Ara (552), Abdur Rahman (399), and subject-wise toppers achieving 332/360 in Biology.

faqs.question: Is there a library or reading room available for self-study?
faqs.answer: Yes! SCIMEE provides an on-premise quiet Reading Room & Library equipped with comfortable individual study cubicles, curated NCERT reference books, and extended daily hours so students can focus without home distractions.

faqs.question: How often are tests conducted?
faqs.answer: Weekly OMR-based mock tests are conducted every Sunday following the exact NTA NEET-UG pattern. Detailed scorecards and error-analysis reports are shared with both students and parents.

faqs.question: Are separate batches available for English and Urdu / Semi-English medium students?
faqs.answer: Yes, our faculty explains core scientific and mathematical concepts with bilingual clarity (English + Hindi/Urdu) so students from State Board, CBSE, and all mediums grasp difficult topics effortlessly.
